legacy-checkout-link.finding: Old-site emails carry /checkout/order-received/<id>/?key=… (and /kasse/…). The retired-checkout redirect preserved the endpoint segment verbatim, but the site renames the endpoint to inquiry-received, so the link landed on /proforma-request/order-received/<id>/ -> 404.
legacy-checkout-link.fix: PR #1005 + #1006: the endpoint slug is read from WC()->query->get_query_vars() (the rename lives in the query-vars filter; the option stays at its default, and wc_get_query_vars() does not exist in this Woo), guarded by did_action('woocommerce_init')
legacy-checkout-link.readback: 2026-11-08 after #1006 deploy: /checkout/order-received/8671/?key=… -> 301 -> /proforma-request/inquiry-received/8671/?key=… -> 200 with the recovery notice; /kasse/ variant identical
